name: not_call_undefined
note: OPA lifts a call's arguments, and a call compared with `==`, out of an enclosing `not`. An undefined lifted term fails the body before the negation runs, so a missing field denies instead of reading as 'does not start with /admin'. A ref compared directly is not lifted, and a defined argument of the wrong type leaves the builtin undefined inside the negation, which holds.
rego:
package authz

default allow = false

allow if {
	not startswith(input.path, "/admin")
	not count(input.tags) == 0
	not input.user == "mallory"
}
